2607.07321.title: From Atomic Actions to Standard Operating Procedures: Iterative Tool Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
2607.07321.paper_summary: Tool utilization enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to interact with the real world and resolve complex tasks. However, existing agent frameworks predominantly rely on static toolsets composed of granular atomic actions (e.g., basic file I/O or single-turn search), which forces agents to reinvent low-level logic for every recurring workflow, leading to increased reasoning overhead and failure rates. In this study, we propose that agents can achieve self-evolution by synthesizing these atomic actions into reusable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), which function as callable higher-order tools that encapsulate multi-step logic. We further introduce EvoSOP, a framework that empowers agents to extract SOPs from execution trajectories and iteratively optimize the toolset through a systematic lifecycle of construction, merging, evaluation, and pruning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EvoSOP significantly boosts task success rates while substantially reducing the number of interaction rounds compared to baselines. Our analysis also reveals that iterative tool optimization fosters reliable and efficient tool-use patterns, providing a scalable pathway for the development of self-evolving agents.
2607.07321.paper_summary_zh: 工具的利用使大型語言模型（LLM）代理能夠與現實世界互動並解決複雜任務。<lb/>然而，現有的代理框架主要依賴由細粒度原子行動組成的靜態工具集（例如，基本的文件I/O或單回合搜索），這迫使代理在每個重複的工作流程中重新發明低級邏輯，導致推理開銷和失敗率的增加。<lb/>在本研究中，我們提出代理可以通過將這些原子行動合成為可重用的標準操作程序（SOPs）來實現自我演化，這些SOPs作為可調用的高階工具，封裝了多步邏輯。<lb/>我們進一步介紹了EvoSOP，一個使代理能夠從執行軌跡中提取SOP並通過系統的構建、合併、評估和修剪生命周期迭代優化工具集的框架。<lb/>大量實驗表明，與基準相比，EvoSOP顯著提高了任務成功率，同時大幅減少了互動回合數。<lb/>我們的分析還顯示，迭代工具優化促進了可靠且高效的工具使用模式，為自我演化代理的發展提供了一條可擴展的途徑。
